notes.title: Crushed Update Alpha 1.1.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38753584/dbf69a01b96f0736409dbd6435db51930da83fc2.png[/img]

[h1]Hello survivors![/h1]

[h3]Crushed Alpha update 1.1.0 is available now![/h3]
Introducing: vehicles, new items, new landscape blending, new loot containers, and much more!

[quote=author]Warning. This is not the final changelog. The news about the update is still being updated.[/quote]
[quote=author]The first thing I want to mention is that Official Wiki Crushed has come out. You can always refer to it at this link: [url=https://crushed.fandom.com/wiki/Crushed_Wiki]Crushed Wiki[/url][/quote]

[h1]Vehicles[/h1]

We've put a lot of work into making the cars appear, and here they are. It may seem that adding cars is literally “adding cars”, but the implementation of features is not always smooth (or rather to say always not smooth). We've completely rewritten how the controller interacts with the game world, and how the player's camera works. Now we use the Cinemachine plugin that Unity provides us. In short, this has given us several advantages in performance, including optimization. Also there were a number of problems in multiplayer and synchronization of machines in it. These are all technical aspects, I just recommend you to find a car in the game world, they are spawned now in three places, and evaluate our work.

[h1]Original Soundtrack[/h1]

Also in collaboration with composer Daniil Homutov the soundtrack for Crushed was written. Right now while playing you can hear these beautiful ambient compositions and immerse yourself in the world of Crushed even more. Also in the near future we will release a special music DLC with the soundtracks in their original quality.

[h1]Points of Interest[/h1]

Two points of interest have been added, Radio Tower and Containers. We want to make the repetitions in the points of interest as few as possible, or eliminate them altogether, except for the basic models of the various props. In general, we will continue to work on them.

[h1]Changes of Map[/h1]

The map has been expanded, the coastal parts have been changed, more natural reliefs have been added, and also a new road leading to the point of interest “Containers” has been added.

[h1]New Landscape Blanding[/h1]

We just made it so that now the landscape looks more realistic by mixing different surfaces on it. For example, if you see a big rock, there will probably be a rock-like surface under it, grass grows only on the surface of the ground, there are some areas where grass does not grow and it looks like a clay surface, and there are small stones scattered around the roads.

[h1]Graphical Improvements[/h1]

Cool running clouds have been added, replacing the bare sky that was previously there. Now the grass shader can cast shadows from the grass, determine the angle of the surface on which it is located, and grow from this at the right angle, as well as the grass is now amenable to procedural wind. It looks great. We also added a new tree species, with orange foliage, just in the spirit of the Scorched Land biome.

[h1]New Loot Containers[/h1]

We've added new containers that you can search. These are a small cooler for food, and a gym bag. Logically, they should spawn different items, and they do. In the fridge you will find food, and in the sports bag various useful items for survival. It is also worth mentioning that they are scattered around the world in different places, they can be found literally everywhere.

[h1]Options[/h1]
We have added features that you have been asking us for a long time. This is Invert Mouse, you can select the axis you need, X or Y. Also added Field of View (FOV) change.

[h1]Saves[/h1]
Now you can save the game at any time you want, the button is located in the ESC menu. Previously you needed a sleeping bag to save the game.

[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38753584/bad88e61ddc2eddc873d56c99c4793345df87fdc.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added new loading screen.
[*] Added in-game tips to the loading screen.
[*] Added weapon Wooden Spear.
[*] Added food Canned Fish.
[*] Added food Chocolate Bar.
[*] Added food Snack Bar.
[*] Added Cooled loot container.
[*] Added Duffle Bag loot container.
[*] Added new trees.
[*] Added option to invert the mouse.
[*] Added option to change Field of View (FOV).
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38753584/5ed78feb757b202d3c0bb4bd977380afa9b37fe9.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed the horizon line between fog and water. Now they have a smooth transition between them.
[*] Fixed blinking of bodies of killed zombies.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38753584/3fab1eb4af5cff9e56be88a897cc82eff99c673c.png[/img]
[list]
[*] The Furnace model has been replaced with a more detailed model.
[*] The look of the in-game console has been updated. Opens with a “~”.
[*] Zombies now have less HP and do less damage.
[*] Increased attack distance (melee) and resource extraction.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38753584/fb3e896c8028a8d5a470f3c83dc2b9b509a2595b.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Removed Metal Spear.
[*] Removed the rudiments of the Green Land biome, as it just wasn't ready.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1355780/Crushed/

The appearance of vehicles, a new model of the oven, new containers for finding items (bags, briefcases, coolers), more food items that can be found, as well as work on a new weapon Assault Rifle. It's hard to say when the weapon will be added, but it will definitely not appear in 1.1.0.

Also an important event is the appearance of [url=https://crushed.fandom.com/wiki/Crushed_Wiki]Crushed Wiki[/url]. Now all the information you are interested in will be there. We need feedback from you. So please don't be shy.

[*] We're experimenting with vehicles.
[*] POIs.

[h1]Hello survivors![/h1]

Let's forget everything old. We added zombies. It was not an easy decision, but we decided to do it. Now there is no survival in the wilderness, but only a zombie apocalypse, where the gameplay is around construction, defense, base repair, loot search in points of interest and so on.

notes.title: Crushed Devblog 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38753584/b4d2a4ce4e3ea4b0fd5d17dfafa73a52e6a692d2.png[/img]

Hello everybody!

We want to tell you a little bit about what we are working on right now and what we have planned for future Crushed updates. This news is rather informational in nature.

[h1]Blueprints[/h1]
We are working on a blueprint system to balance your progress and add more fan, because to find the blueprints you will need to leave your base and explore the open world.

[h1]Electricity[/h1]
Electricity will include energy sources, energy storage, consumers and a control panel. We plan to gradually add new electrical facilities.

[h1]Objects Durability[/h1]
The tools will cease to be eternal. After their breakdown, they will have to be repaired for resources. It will happen on an anvil, a special workbench or a regular workbench in an additional tab - it's hard to say right now.

[h1]Food Freshness[/h1]
Now food can be spoiled, just like in the real world. It will no longer be possible to store huge stocks of meat and mushrooms in boxes. To prevent spoilage of food, you need a refrigerator.

[h1]Rebalancing[/h1]
A game in which you can build a base for yourself in 10-15 minutes - does not challenge the player. We will complicate the task of resource extraction and development. This will affect both the amount of resources extracted and the size of the stacks.

[h1]Map[/h1]
Map - to be! In order to open it, it will be necessary to carry it with you. It can also fall out of you after death.

notes.title: Crushed Update 0.0.5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38753584/1c096e6d68845cfb6e2c9baf1b979441aca11f48.png[/img]

[h1]Hello survivors![/h1]

[h3]Without many words. This is the largest update released for Crushed to date.[/h3]
A lot of work has been done. Many lines of Legacy code have been rewritten, new graphical improvements have been introduced, and many systems on which Crushed worked previously have been rewritten. We are looking forward to your feedback!

Attention! Your saves from previous versions are still available, but will not work correctly. We recommend starting a new game for version 0.0.5! 

[h3]Update Alpha 0.0.5:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The technical part of the inventory has been completely updated. This will allow us to implement various features that we have planned for the future. And it also helped to fix minor bugs now, but more on that in the changelog.
[*] The technical part of changing the time of day has been completely updated. It has become more flexible, we have added the moon, and now the change of day is synchronized in multiplayer.
[*] We are now using the [url=https://docs.unity3d.com/Manual/class-ReflectionProbe.html]Reflection Probe's[/url]. This added more realism to the picture without sacrificing performance.
[*] We changed the standard Unity tools that were responsible for drawing fog and grass on the terrain. Now the grass has increased the range of drawing, reacts to the wind and also casts shadows.
[*] The visual design of the character's characteristics has been updated. This is just a small part of the HUD that we managed to update. Further improvements will be related to Quality of Life, such as the display of picked up items.
[*] Added the ability to change the hotkey bindings in the settings. This is the innovation that we have taken as a top priority, thanks to your feedback. Therefore, we ask you to leave your wishes as often as possible.
[*] Added in-game chat. Now you don't have to communicate with your friends using voice chat programs. You can also make new acquaintances right inside the game.
[*] The character controller has also undergone major overhauls. The movement has become smoother, and there will now be much less getting stuck, or moments where you cannot jump onto the foundation of your house.
[*] Added console. This is the very beginning in creating some kind of customization of the gaming session. In the future, we plan to add several game modes, among which there is «Creative mode». Here you can see the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1355780/discussions/0/3055114073642734686/]list of available commands[/url].
[*] We've updated the game map. Again. Now, for these purposes, we use a convenient generator that allows you to create a realistic landscape, easily modify it and automate many routine processes in the work of a level designer.
[*] Added augmented extended statuses. Now in the list of friends you can see what day of survival your friend is on. [url=https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/features/enhancedrichpresence]Learn more about enhanced extended statuses[/url].
[/list]

[h3]Changelog:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated game map.
[*] The technical part of the inventory has been completely updated.
[*] The technical part of changing the time of day has been completely updated.
[*] The save system has been updated.
[*] Added console.
[*] Added different spawn points for the character.
[*] Added damage when falling from a height.
[*] Added jumping and landing sounds.
[*] Added augmented advanced Steam statuses.
[*] Added loot crates floating on the shore.
[*] Added in-game chat.
[*] Added Reflection Probe's.
[*] Added new tree models.
[*] Added new stone models.
[*] Added LOD to house construction objects.
[*] Added a new grass shader.
[*] Added a new fog shader.
[*] Added a new skybox.
[*] Added time of day synchronization in multiplayer.
[*] Added the ability to change the hotkey bindings.
[*] Added function to enable / disable PVP in settings.
[*] The visual design of the character's characteristics has been updated.
[*] The functionality of the game settings has been updated.
[*] The damage done by the bear has been reduced.
[*] Changed bear hitbox.
[*] Added new bear attack animations.
[*] Visual update of the time of day.
[*] Added sound when destroying an object with a mallet.
[*] Updated pickup sound.
[*] The Flare Gun now fires with a 1.5 second delay.
[*] Increased the sensitivity of the mouse wheel when scrolling through the crafting menu.
[*] Added construction objects «Staircase» and «Corner staircase».
[*] The «Medium Farm» construction object has been added and the «Large Farm» model has been replaced.
[*] The volume of some sounds has been changed.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed problem loading local save if Steam client was closed.
[*] Fixed the appearance of cracks during the construction of house objects.
[*] Fixed playing of footstep sounds in some parts of the terrain.
[*] Fixed AI responsiveness to previews of some building objects.
[*] Fixed the first person running animation playing when opening the inventory while running.
[*] Fixed frequent playing of bear attack sounds when starting a chase.
[*] Fixed the synchronization of damage dealt to the bear in multiplayer.
[*] Fixed a bug with the disappearance of a killed bear for other players, except for the host.
[*] Fixed propagation distance of bear sounds.
[*] Fixed a bear getting stuck in place when starting a patrol.
[*] Fixed the play of the bear attack animation, now it plays to the end.
[*] Fixed being able to shoot with the Flare Gun. if the pause menu is open.
[*] Fixed blurring of the thumbnail screenshot of the game in the save menu when saving the game.
[*] Fixed a problem with loading the contents of crates when loading a save for all players except the host.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38753584/c3ab8d4dd5b7f742a735d72dc8b07b5c433b6dca.png[/img]

Hello survivors!

Alpha 0.0.3a is available for download on Steam. We are happy to provide you with a list of changes.

[h3]Update Alpha 0.0.3a:[/h3]

Changes:
- Changed loading screen

Fixed:
- Fixed a critical bug that made it impossible to save progress in multiplayer
- Fixed infinite collection of cannabis if the player was not the creator of the room
- Fixed a bug with displaying the cursor in the main menu for players after the creator left the game
- Fixed in some cases incorrect loading of players' buildings in online mode
- Fixed a bug related to receiving damage from the zone at the edges of the map
- For players (except the creator), saving game on the sleeping bag is displayed more prominently

notes.title: Update Alpha 0.0.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38753584/759a8a899412aa0c3dacc0a072475f4676b9dbe6.png[/img]

Hello survivors!

Alpha 0.0.2 is available for download on Steam. We are happy to provide you with a list of changes.

[h3]Update Alpha 0.0.2:[/h3]

New:
- Added «Flare Gun»
- Added «Iron Stones» to the location
- Added new tool «Pickaxe»
- Added item «First Aid Kit»
- Added item «Canteen»
- Added the ability to change the color of the «Pointer» icon
- Added resource extraction mechanics
- Added Occlusion Culling
- Updated servers
- Conducted refactoring of the construction system
- Refactoring of the weapon system
- Added and partially redesigned new UI
- Added new item icons
- Added a new building object «Wooden Table»
- Updated terrain textures
- Updated grass textures
- Added new footstep sounds
- The Sleeping Bag can now be used as a spawn point
- Added a button for selecting a region
- Added a new designation for the map border

Changes:
- Inventory can be opened by pressing TAB and I
- Updated the principle of authorization on game servers
- Dropped items are removed from the location after 5 minutes
- Sounds of footsteps are transmitted over the network
- Optimized tree mesh
- Items in wooden boxes are now synchronized over the network
- Updated localization in some places
- Changed the lighting on the location
- The door is now installed correctly in the doorway
- HP of constructed objects can only be seen with a mallet in hand
- Constructed objects can only be destroyed with a mallet
- Updated workbench collision
- Now HP of an object can be more than 100
- Buildings and structures can no longer be installed if they are interfered with by another constructed object
- Some parts of structures can now be rotated when installed on the Q/E keys
- Doors now can be opened
- Now when you completely use up stamina, you can not immediately activate running
- Received damage from hunger and thirst is different
- Increased the installation range of objects by 50%
- Increased the connection range of structural objects by 20%

Fixed:
- Fixed animation of «Glow Stick»
- Fixed a bug related to the installation of objects on trees
- Fixed slipping of hands into objects
- Removed hand shadows on surfaces
- Fixed synchronization of dropped items
- Fixed increased movement speed when walking diagonally
- Now you can not place objects if they are in contact with the player
- Fixed a bug of inability to re-sow on a garden bed after harvesting
- Fixed stamina recovery when inventory is open
- Fixed flickering of a building object, at the time of the start of construction
- During construction, it is now impossible to interact with interactive objects
- Now stamina is not spent there is a jump was unsuccessful
- Other minor fixes


If you like the game or believe in its success, [b]feel free to leave your feedback on Steam[/b], and connect to our [url=https://discord.com/invite/ZUnwsKa]Discord[/url] server.

notes.title: Crushed has been released for the Early Access!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38753584/d345ca443f60148fe8d905e926712f1e2eae2926.png[/img]

Hello survivors!

I am happy to announce that Crushed is available for purchase in Early Access today, November 23th, 09:00 PST.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1355780/Crushed/

Crushed is not without its problems in the early access stage, you can really come across errors, illogical moments or other glitches. Our task is to correct them and develop the project with your feedback. If you are in doubt about whether to buy the game right now, I recommend that you wait for a more stable version of the game. I definitely believe that Crushed will be a great representative of the Survival genre if we keep polishing it. Thank you for your support.

[h3]What can you do in the game right now?[/h3]

- Resist natural needs
- Build a base
- Engage in farming
- Explore the available territory
- Play with your friends

If you like the game or believe in its success, [b]feel free to leave your feedback on Steam[/b], and connect to our [url=https://discord.com/invite/ZUnwsKa]Discord[/url] server.

Ilya Kozhevnikov, CEO of NipoBox

notes.title: Crushed Devblog 1
notes.content:
Hi everyone! This is Ilya, lead developer of the Crushed project. Today I will tell you how the development is progressing and what has been done recently.

[h3]Day&Night Cycle[/h3]

We are almost done with the day / night cycle. It was quite difficult to work with it, but we did it and are happy to share the results of the work done.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38753584/11fa0ec8ad7e5cde1414f5d589726bf633796ddb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38753584/a0f6cec61c987c97340042d9a6095874f0a12b49.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38753584/fe103bc561c194f85aaf75f51dd75fa5ee485fba.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38753584/6a6af24ce89c32b8bc6d3af0e7bd8f1fdc0b6d16.png[/img]

[h3]Farm[/h3]

Work on the farm system is also ongoing. At the time of the release of the alpha version, one plant culture, tissue, will be available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38753584/cd981fd3ff0e0affc01451e1e424d17319f275d2.png[/img]

[h3]Label[/h3]

We have introduced special labels, the icon of which will be visible across the entire map, so that you can mark the unique and necessary places for you. Also in the future we will add the ability to change the color of this label.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38753584/509e04b1f9adace94fc38818e9ec04dee10247ee.png[/img]

Thank you for your attention. We are waiting for your feedback in the comments.
